title: Transcriptomic profiling to investigate the therapeutic potential and medicinal properties of Momordica cymbalaria.
authors: Krishnakumar, Heyram; Nallusamy, Saranya; Rajmichael, Raji; Mathimaran, Ahila; Pandian, Chitra Jeyaraj; Subramanian, Gomathinayagam; Jeyaraman, Jeyakanthan
one_liner_zh: 该文对苦瓜属植物进行转录组测序与表达分析，虽提及转录因子家族但与DNA互作无关，无AI或物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Momordica cymbalaria (Athalakkai), a medicinally important Cucurbitaceae species, is widely used in traditional medicine due to its antidiabetic, anticancer, and antimicrobial properties. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying its therapeutic potential remain poorly understood. Here, we present a comprehensive transcriptome analysis of M. cymbalaria using Illumina HiSeq 4000 sequencing of leaf, fruit, and seed tissues. De novo assembly generated 450,785 contigs (N50: 460 bp) with 72,283 annotated unigenes. Our key findings reveal pivotal genes involved in the biosynthesis of pharmaceutically relevant secondary metabolites, including terpenoids, steroids, and isoquinoline alkaloids. Notably, enzymes such as hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase, cycloeucalenol cycloisomerase, and tyrosine aminotransferase were recognized as central to these pathways. Gene Ontology (GO) analysis has classified the transcripts into molecular functions (181,789), biological processes (242,672), and cellular components (126,350). We further characterized 5,025 transcription factors, with bHLH, MYB, and WRKY families being prominently associated with secondary metabolism regulation. Tissue-specific expression patterns were identified and validated by qRT-PCR, showing eminent metabolic activity in leaves and fruits compared to seeds. This study provides the first genomic resource for M. cymbalaria, offering molecular insights into its medicinal properties and facilitating future biotechnological applications in drug discovery.
abstract_zh: Momordica cymbalaria (Athalakkai) 是一种具有重要药用价值的葫芦科物种，因其抗糖尿病、抗癌和抗菌特性而广泛用于传统医学。然而，其治疗潜力背后的分子机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用 Illumina HiSeq 4000 对叶、果实和种子组织进行测序，呈现了 M. cymbalaria 的综合转录组分析。从头组装生成了 450,785 个重叠群（N50: 460 bp），其中包含 72,283 个已注释的单基因。我们的关键发现揭示了参与药物相关次生代谢物生物合成的关键基因，包括萜类、甾体和异喹啉生物碱。值得注意的是，羟甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶、环真核烯环异构酶和酪氨酸转氨酶等酶被认定是这些途径的核心。基因本体论 (GO) 分析将转录本分类为分子功能 (181,789)、生物过程 (242,672) 和细胞组分 (126,350)。我们进一步表征了 5,025 个转录因子，其中 bHLH、MYB 和 WRKY 家族与次生代谢调控显著相关。组织特异性表达模式被鉴定并通过 qRT-PCR 验证，显示叶和果实中的代谢活性显著高于种子。本研究为 M. cymbalaria 提供了首个基因组资源，为其药用特性提供了分子见解，并促进了未来药物发现中的生物技术应用。
